headline: Updating ADH to 2026 needs one new parameter: a recovery rate rho = -0.17 (approx 0) turns the reversible flow shock into a hysteresis model where the manufacturing hit is permanent (net level elasticity -0.43) and the 2019-24 import reversal produced no rebound (+0.06pp vs the +0.35pp the original model predicts).

tables.title: Level test: is the China-shock hit permanent? (2SLS, 722 CZs, per $1k accumulated 2000-12 exposure)

figures.caption: From a static reversible flow shock to a dynamic incidence with hysteresis. A: one constant ADH elasticity can't fit all eras (it fades from -0.28 to +0.05). B: high-exposure CZs downshifted and stayed scarred. C: the level hit is permanent (recovery approx 0; net = full impact; star = ADH's reversible prediction). D: held-out 2019-24 reversal - ADH symmetric predicts a +0.35 rebound, actual is +0.06, hysteresis predicts approx 0.
figures.alt: Four-panel figure: era-drift of the flow elasticity, permanent level scar by exposure group, level-test coefficients with the reversible prediction marked, and the held-out reversal test.

figures.caption: Manufacturing-employment scarring is permanent: high-exposure commuting zones fell far more during the China shock and never recovered after imports receded (recovery rate rho approx 0).
figures.alt: Line chart of manufacturing employment-share change vs 2000 for high- and low-exposure CZs, 2000-2023, with the shock period shaded.

notes: Updated model = directional-hysteresis (ratchet) incidence, the smallest amendment to ADH: flow shock (import growth, now ~0/negative) drives current losses only while positive; stock legacy (accumulated exposure) sets the permanent level. Alternatives rejected: time-varying elasticity (no cross-era discipline, no OOS prediction) and pure-stock model (understates the active-shock impact).

The recovery rate is CALIBRATED from the well-instrumented level test (dose F approx 30); the direct flow-split 2SLS recovery leg is weakly identified (partial F=2.2) because the 8-country instrument does not track the US-specific post-2018 reversal. All approaches agree rho<1 and the level effect is permanent.
Outcome is 001's CBP-jobs manufacturing-share proxy (validated at W2), not ADH's Census/ACS measure (IPUMS unavailable). No data re-fetched; all inputs reused from followup/001.
Labels: [ESTIMATED] from data, [CALIBRATED] parameter matched to a moment, [PROPOSED] theoretical suggestion not itself tested.
